The suspicious python.exe on nashua is not a sniffer: all 348 of its network connections go to a single destination 192.168.0.4:8443, i.e. outbound C2-style traffic rather than promiscuous capture of other hosts' traffic. Zeek (2020-04-30) does not overlap the Windows window and shows no ICMP conn records, so it cannot corroborate or refute sniffing.
